metadata.title: DIY Home Decor|Paper Cups Light Garland
metadata.description:
Using plastic cups and scrapbook paper you can create a unique home decor for your room or anywhere you want to display your light garland. Thanks for watching!

M A T E R I A L S
One 9oz paper cup
50/or however many plastic cups you want
scrapbook paper
double sided tape
scissors
utility knife
light garland (of course!)

summary.brief: A crafter cuts, decorates, and hangs paper cups on a string of lights to make a light garland.
summary.detailed: The video begins by showing the supplies—paper cups, scrapbook paper, double‑sided tape, scissors, a utility knife, a pencil and a string of small white LED lights—arranged on a white surface. The crafter holds a paper cup, cuts it lengthwise through the middle, removes the entire bottom, and trims away excess paper so the cup becomes a shallow ring. The cup is placed on a sheet of scrapbook paper, traced around with a pencil, and the traced paper is cut out to match the cup shape. Double‑sided tape is applied to the inner rim of the cup, excess tape is trimmed, and the cut scrapbook paper is adhered around the cup. Using the utility knife an X‑shaped hole is cut in the bottom of the cup to accept a tiny light bulb. This whole process is repeated for several cups. Once all cups are wrapped and prepared, they are attached to the string of LED lights, forming a decorative light garland that is displayed hanging against a plain white wall, with a small black object visible in the lower‑right corner. The video ends with a thank‑you message and brief end‑credits.

action.detailed: Cut each cup, apply double‑sided tape, wrap the cup with traced scrapbook paper, cut an X‑shaped hole in the bottom, insert the bulbs, and hang the cups on the string of lights.

A hand brings a decorative scrapbook sheet and an upside‑down paper cup into view. Using scissors, the cup is cut vertically through its middle, the bottom is removed, and the excess sides are trimmed to create a clean cylindrical piece. The trimmed cup is placed on the scrapbook paper, and a pencil is used to trace the cup’s outline onto the paper, forming a template for later assembly.

Using plastic cups and scrapbook paper you can create a unique home decor for your room or anywhere you want to display your light garland. Thanks for watching!

M A T E R I A L S
One 9oz paper cup
50/or however many plastic cups you want
scrapbook paper
double sided tape
scissors
utility knife
light garland (of course!)
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video begins by showing the supplies—paper cups, scrapbook paper, double‑sided tape, scissors, a utility knife, a pencil and a string of small white LED lights—arranged on a white surface. The crafter holds a paper cup, cuts it lengthwise through the middle, removes the entire bottom, and trims away excess paper so the cup becomes a shallow ring. The cup is placed on a sheet of scrapbook paper, traced around with a pencil, and the traced paper is cut out to match the cup shape. Double‑sided tape is applied to the inner rim of the cup, excess tape is trimmed, and the cut scrapbook paper is adhered around the cup. Using the utility knife an X‑shaped hole is cut in the bottom of the cup to accept a tiny light bulb. This whole process is repeated for several cups. Once all cups are wrapped and prepared, they are attached to the string of LED lights, forming a decorative light garland that is displayed hanging against a plain white wall, with a small black object visible in the lower‑right corner. The video ends with a thank‑you message and brief end‑credits.

     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an

     home, city street), driving / cycling / hiking POV footage, drone

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)
